images.title: 197 squared via a round 200
images.purpose: Shows 197² worked as (197 + 3)(197 − 3) + 3², with the + 3 that makes 200 highlighted.
images.composition: A short worked layout centred: three lines stacked top to bottom. Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, no scenery, no people, no extra text.
images.exact_structure: Line 1: the label '197 + 3 = 200' with '200' in a reddish purple (#CC79A7) highlight box, and beside it the label '197 − 3 = 194' in teal (#0072B2). Line 2: the label '197² = 200 × 194 + 3²'. Line 3: the label '38800 + 9 = 38809' with '38809' in amber (#E69F00). A short down arrow between each line. Exactly 3 lines and 2 arrows.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec

images.takeaway: Pick b so that a + b is round: a² = (a + b)(a − b) + b².
images.description: Shows 197² worked as (197 + 3)(197 − 3) + 3², with the + 3 that makes 200 highlighted.

image_decisions.why: The highlight shows the one choice that makes the method quick, rounding up to 200.
